# Qualification vendor provenance

Based on crates.io `monstertruck-geometry 0.4.1`, archive SHA-256 `cee8ce45200826a20c752ae24c82f5048dcddd2f168230c1799c214b804d6f40`, Apache-2.0. The reviewed scratch archive comparison covered 104 archive files; only `src/decorators/processor/mod.rs` differs. Registry cache metadata and nested lockfiles are omitted.

The local change forwards source-declared analytic surface singularities through Processor, including inverse parameter-axis mapping. It is scoped to the isolated qualification workspace.

Source: `.evidence/monstertruck-qualification/step-sphere-vertex-loop-v1/revision-v7-combined-current/`, freeze SHA-256 `f9cb21e0afd40c950452908e407445d8181f64a7a5c8612585c4dd2ed1cf588a`. This receipt corrects the scratch receipts' cross-crate filename typo; source bytes are unchanged.

## Subsequent reviewed corrections

Kernel-v22 corrects `NurbsCurve::parameter_range` to delegate to the stored B-spline active domain, with source-bound STEP and geometry regressions. Frozen patch SHA-256 `348f71c87ab2792a19c5ed7b25ce574601bb41ebe7022fb9fd80ce06f6c465b5`; evidence: `.evidence/monstertruck-qualification/step-active-domain-v1/`.

Projection-v23 corrects sphere inverse membership to use the existing linear spatial tolerance instead of comparing squared radii to a linear cutoff, and rejects invalid normalization inputs. Frozen patch SHA-256 `f2e5a29d678138bbd03c2606344795cba6d6eb4952f1c805e68b40bc1d3a9d9d`; evidence: `.evidence/monstertruck-qualification/dish-face-division-v1/`. Near-pole and extreme-scale inverse limitations remain under qualification.

Sphere-v25 applies reviewed stable hypot/atan2 inverse evaluation and spatial reconstruction checks, preserving exact-query versus nearest-projection semantics and explicit signed-zero center handling. Patch SHA-256 `9ea116c51bd92d5f3a4c820f12d73faa70cb6c6dd6b9abe4ca269f44a264662b`; evidence: `.evidence/monstertruck-qualification/sphere-inverse-accuracy-v2/`. Integration adds only the Standards-requested regression-name comment. Near-pole tests pass; unrepresentable extreme-scale results explicitly refuse, and arbitrary affine/world-space accuracy remains unqualified.

Cone-v26 repairs exact-axis revolution inversion, retains valid finite Processor seeds when singular refinement fails, and maps inverted surface hints into entity coordinates. The new exact/fallback guards use Euclidean spatial distance at the existing tolerance. Source geometry and parameter ranges are unchanged. Reviewed complete patch SHA-256 `bd84101152cd37bedceec1ff6588e114247f1c28dc313ff29865f6864d321d3c`; evidence: `.evidence/monstertruck-qualification/step-cone-domain-v2/`. Full Choc mesh winding, degeneracy and import acceptance remain unqualified.

Derivative-v31 selects the incoming basis span for derivative ranks greater than zero at structurally continuous active upper endpoints. Rank-zero geometry, interior conventions and discontinuous padded endpoint behavior remain unchanged. Reviewed final patch SHA256 `4fd0146dae7a4013caadd33702ef45d444b7797b1d98ff4e0b29b8cd38478c80`; source, public regressions and independent oracle receipts: `.evidence/monstertruck-qualification/angular-incidence-regression-v1/active-endpoint-derivative-v1/HANDOFF-v2.md`. Two unrelated Circle hint assertions fail on the same baseline seed and remain explicitly excluded from the affected geometry suite; no whole-model acceptance is inferred.

Circle-v34: integrate reviewed Circle stable atan2 inverse and Processor parameter-hint mapping; combined patch c5480b39d0fbc6daccb2bec5d684212078c48db45be9a98ae2c98c6bb7413592. Preserve the surface-v33 affine-plane capability.

Endpoint-v38 adds exact finite endpoint exchange and caller-label preservation through reversed Processor divisions when child endpoints exactly match the requested domain. Child XYZ, interior labels and refusals are preserved. Reviewed five-file patch SHA256 `bc48c73b86bfe1b6fc85d417af9610cbfeb8267562c701ee324b3191788ed000`; final evidence `.evidence/monstertruck-qualification/vik-circle-regression-v1/final-receipt-ledger.json`. The private 30-mode prior-PASS corpus succeeds; shared combined gates are recorded under `vendor-integration/endpoint-v38/`. The separate torus off-domain caller remains unresolved.

Plane-v40 retains authored Plane coefficients and their affine transform, forwards exact plane certificates through Processor, and preserves legacy identity arithmetic and signed-zero values. The reviewed v3 source and compatibility boundary are frozen under `.evidence/monstertruck-qualification/plane-source-transform-v3/primitive-freeze-v1/`; full patch SHA256 `a4c879d1964a93a04a9e98d282dc20ed5a9a04c12d52f811ba6667b5abd00157`. Integration preserves the existing workspace configuration and takes only approved source postimages; combined checks are recorded under `vendor-integration/plane-v40/`. Serialization of transformed planes requires updated readers; cache compatibility and whole-curve STEP composition remain separate gates.

Choc-v41 integrates the reviewed finite-boundary coefficient proof and ordinary inferred-chart route, preserving successful aligned source samples before chart reconstruction. This is finite boundary equality, not periodicity or general surface injectivity. Final reviewed production patch SHA256 `2769aef56108ac12a86b8d2047cc8df976dcfdd3eb9263103122f79e5e1b4d1c`; final private source manifest `f2b66f3445084aacec04adab536bc78cc6919aaba0071caf1fb0bb69a7965bbe`. Two adjacent trait/derive capability additions are separately reviewed with Plane-v40 (composition patch `77697632c0345708a50e7641e82369826a7e5a3c211bffdd6b7365dba7b13c25`). Frozen evidence: `.evidence/monstertruck-qualification/choc-default-incidence-proof-v1/`; shared combined checks: `vendor-integration/choc-v41/`. Existing rejected heuristics and endpoint-loss predecessors remain rejected; whole STEP/feature acceptance and OCCT/C++ removal remain open.

## Reviewed finite collapsed-boundary support (2026-10-17)

Collapsed-pole-v49 integrates the reviewed finite polynomial B-spline point-boundary proof, wrapper forwarding and axis-specific shared-sample projection. Proof transport requires a conservative affine determinant enclosure excluding zero; unsupported or ambiguous source cases receive no proof. Original source geometry and shared XYZ samples are retained. Combined patch SHA-256 `f804cd140dd3dab104f775f26f0fc8f098a9b646fe87511ae2760e8e3b164990`; immutable candidate and both review axes: `.evidence/production-step-007/collapsed-v-pole-fix/`. Actual shared integration receipts: `.evidence/monstertruck-qualification/vendor-integration/collapsed-pole-v49/`. This does not certify arbitrary source trim coverage, whole-shell closure or collision accuracy.
